claim: Combine Assets with positive medium-term trend should be favored and weak trends should be cut earlier. WITH Regime-aware trend rules should avoid weak market conditions and reduce drawdown.
causal_mechanism: Trend persistence and behavioral anchoring can create continuation across 24/52 week windows. Combined with: Adaptive markets imply strategy edge changes by volatility and trend regime.
expected_effect: Improve 24/52 week stability versus SPY and parent while avoiding duplicate artifacts.
falsification_rule: Reject if selected universe, trades, or artifacts duplicate parent, or if monthly/yearly SPY comparison does not improve.
